source: Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animals (https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html), CC0, FBX
note: Each model is a rigged, animated skeletal mesh (own skeleton, walk/run/idle/eat/death clips) imported to /Game/Rim3D/Generated/Animals/<model>. `lengthM` is each model's real nose-to-tail length in metres (U15 fits the imported mesh to it, the import is about 3 times too big); `scale` is the multiplier on that size for the def's body size; a def with no real model yet is under `missing` and keeps its code-built shapes. Retargeting onto shared skeletons is left for U15.
